reactions.description: SneP catalyzes C–C and an ether linkage on the YSYY motif
SneP catalyzes biaryl C-C and biaryl ether cross-link on the precursor peptide SneA, before the release of mature crosslinked peptide YSYY. SneA: MILTGALFARLTRKDRLTLPYSYY
